appraisal_events.evidence: Sans enthousiasme, mais avec chemise de nuit pour si le prince vous demandait de rester à coucher, ce qu'il faisait d'ailleurs rarement, en parfait mufle qu'il était, comme tous les Orléans.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchesse turns the duc's own hypocrisy argument back on him (his weekly Chantilly dinners with a descendant of a reviled revolutionary figure) and then mockingly undercuts his claim of reluctance, implying he was in fact eager despite his protest.

status_effects.explanation: He is mildly and playfully diminished as his wife exposes the gap between his self-righteous stance and his own comparable (or worse) conduct, then mocks his claimed indifference to Chantilly.

ambiguities: The speaker of the opening line ('Alors, duc de Guermantes, pourquoi alliez-vous dîner...') is not explicitly tagged; attribution to the duchesse is inferred from the couple's established pattern of addressing each other by full title in dialogue.

Swann's brief correction about having sent the photograph, and the duchesse's deflection onto her servants, is peripheral banter with no clear resulting appraisal shift for Swann and was left unscored.
Mme de Saint-Euverte is mentioned only as the host of an upcoming dinner and has no local evaluative content of her own in this passage.
